# dossier.yaml
version: 1
language: en
counterparts:
  - name: "Acme Consulting"
    role: "ordering party"
    contacts: [ "Jane Doe" ]
  - name: "Northwind Bank"
    role: "end client"
confidential_names: [ "Northwind Bank", "Northwind" ]
consent_recorded: false
consent_source: ""
timestamps: "@mm:ss"
date_format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
status_header: required
staleness_days: 7
# Dossier

This folder is the living memory of the relationship: seven files, each one topic, each line
dated and sourced.

One fact per line. Every line carries a date and a source (a transcript timestamp, a mail, a
file and page). A line without a source is an opinion and says so.

Correct a line rather than add a contradictory one. Each file opens with its own dated header
line, updated whenever the file changes.

- `ACTORS.md` — who is who on every side, grouped by side.
- `HISTORY.md` — chronology, commitments in progress, upcoming.
- `LEARNINGS.md` — how the counterpart speaks and thinks, what the case teaches.
- `TONE.md` — the voice, what is established, the Refused log.
- `CHANNELS.md` — how we communicate and this repository's confidentiality level.
- `OPEN-QUESTIONS.md` — answered, still open, what we would ask the end client.
- `RELATIONSHIP.md` — status, numbers, views, improvements, opportunities.

# Outbound

Every file in this folder opens with a status header, verbatim:

```
Status: draft | reviewed by <name> | sent <date time> by <name>
To: <recipient>
Subject: <subject>            (mails)
Deadline: YYYY-MM-DD          (optional: when the draft has to be sent)
Written by: <human or "agent session, YYYY-MM-DD">
Rules: no confidential names; see knowledge/DOCTRINE.md
```

Files are named `YYYY-MM-DD_slug` (plus their extension).

- `deliverables/` — a rendered file keeps its source file beside it, same stem.
- `mails/` — one file per message.
- `calls/` — preparation, then minutes.

Two standing rules: no confidential name ever appears in a file under this folder, and nothing
leaves this repository without a human sending it.

<!-- What has been explicitly requested? By whom, and by when? -->

<!-- What existing assets, data or tools does the client already have? -->

<!-- Which sources under sources/ ground this context? -->
# Doctrine

## What we say

<!-- What do we commit to in every engagement? What is always true, whatever the case? -->

## What we never say

- A start date before the scoping call has been held (decision 2026-09-20 by Sam).
